purpose: Teach: メモリアル/ハウル/ヨドバシカメラ/ポケモン/ファミコン/東宝/オカルト/サントリー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと戦没者メモリアル碑を訪ねた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, I remember visiting that war memorial with Dad.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Slow opening, warm but tinged with loss. Each phrase given space to settle. Trailing voice on the end, not closing the thought—letting it hang.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ハウル映画をご覧になったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—and your grandfather, he did watch that Howl film, didn't he?
lines.style: Gentle redirection, testing his memory with affection. A light lilt at the end—not correcting, but gently nudging. Warm and a touch mischievous, like she knows something he's forgotten.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがヨドバシカメラの常連だった
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Dad was always at the Yodobashi camera shop. Never missed a day.
lines.style: Quiet certainty beneath the wistfulness. Not fighting her corrections—just placing his own memory down carefully. Eyes somewhere in the past. Slower pace, deliberate.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様のポケモンカードを集めて下さってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your grandfather, he was always buying Pokemon cards for the grandchildren, wasn't he?
lines.style: Warm knowing in her voice. She's not asking—she's reminding him of who he was. Affectionate tease. Slight emphasis on 'always,' like she's holding up a mirror.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがファミコンの登場に驚かれた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Dad was so amazed when the Famicom first came out. I can still see his face.
lines.style: Softer still. A smile underneath, almost imperceptible. The voice of someone holding a single bright moment. Slow breath between phrases. Very gentle trailing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、東宝の特撮映画にお詳しかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, he knew so much about Toho's special effects films. All of those old movies.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact affection. She's cataloguing him—his interests, his knowledge—like she's making sure these details are preserved in sound. Warm, steady. A slight uptick of pride in her voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがオカルト雑誌を読まれて笑ってらした
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Dad used to read those occult magazines and laugh at himself about it.
lines.style: A small private laugh in the memory. Tender embarrassment for his father—the kind of love that comes with seeing someone's quirks. Warm, almost conspiratorial. Soft trailing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、サントリーの角瓶をお気に入りだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather always had a soft spot for Suntory Kaku whisky, didn't he? His favorite.
lines.style: Closing gentle. Warm, steady. A small satisfied smile in the voice—the last detail placed down. She's finishing the picture of him. Quiet, assured, like a final brush stroke.
